scope: Bridge rule for natural-unit fixture rows before any public physical or dimensional claim.

bridge_rule.rule: Any natural-unit scalar-route quantity intended for public physical interpretation must state its SI bridge dependencies or remain fixture-only.
official_context: NIST SI pages define SI around base/derived units and defining constants.
NIST SP 330 records c and h as exact defining constants in the revised SI.
NIST SP 811 Chapter 5 recognizes natural units for basic science but requires identifying the specific unit system.

allowed: A bridge is required before physical unit claims.
Natural units are retained as fixture-only context.
forbidden: Natural units close the unit problem.
The scalar sector is physically validated.

evidence: NIST sources support the need to identify units and constants clearly.
context: The v462A v7 natural-unit fixture remains useful for review.
hypothesis: A future SI bridge may make candidate rows auditable.
blocker: No row-level SI conversion is completed in v2.
advisory: Keep all natural-unit rows fixture-only until conversion rows exist.
